name: Vulcanusmon
main_effect:
When this card would be played, if you have fewer Digimon than your opponent, reduce the cost by 5.
[On Play] [When Digivolving] You may link up to 2 cards from your hand or trash to any of your Digimon without paying the cost. Then, for each of your link cards, ＜De-Digivolve 1＞ all of your opponent's Digimon. (Trash the top card. You can't trash past level 3 cards.)
[All Turns] All of your [TS] trait Digimon gain ＜Rush＞ (This Digimon can attack the turn it comes into play.) and ＜Link +1＞ (Add 1 to this Digimon's maximum links.)
[Your Turn] When your Digimon get linked, one of them may attack.
